{{Top|leg}}
A '''sensor net''' was a piece of technology used as a detection device.<ref name="STRONG">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref><ref name="AJ10">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 10]]</ref>

Sensor nets were created by overlapping [[sensor]] fields in order to detect an object passing through them.<ref name="STRONG" /> Ranging in coverage size, they could be used on terrestrial locations such bases and camps, or be deployed across entire systems.<ref name="STRONG" />

[[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamaris]] first line of defense was a sensor net produced by [[Sensor buoy/Legends|sensor buoys]] that scanned [[hyperspace route]]s leading to the planet.<ref name="STRONG" /> The planet of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] likewise had a [[Star system|system]] wide net that had to be deactivated on the planet by [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Alliance]] could destroy [[Jyrenne Base]].<ref name="AJ10" />

While on [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] inadvertently triggered a sensor net, alerting [[J'uoch]]'s [[J'uoch's mining camp|mining camp]] to his presence.
